theorems.name: Submission.idtp_pc_orient_ae_eq_or_neg
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (τ : Fin n → Euclid P), Orthonormal ℝ τ → μHE[n] (R.carrier \ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) : Set (Euclid P))) = 0 → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict R.carrier), (∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, R.orient x α = α τ) ∨ (∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, R.orient x α = -α τ)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
